name: Ocala Outdoor Adventure Camp Leadership Camp
org: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC), Ocala Conservation Center
what_you_do: High school students help staff with camper activities at an overnight nature camp. They get training in the camp programs and in working with children.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 16 and 17 who apply and are accepted.
pay_detail: $200 per week. 40 Service Learning Credits are awarded for each week.
deadline_text: The page lists summer weeks from June 14 to July 31 (no camp June 28 to July 3). No application deadline is stated.
how_to_apply: Fill out the leadership camp application on the camp page. Then follow the steps to contact the camp. You only sign up online if you are accepted.
notes: The camp address is 7325 NE 170th Ave, Silver Springs, FL. Phone 352-625-2804. The page does not name the year of the listed weeks, so confirm 2027 dates.
